annotations.title: Legal limits on attorney fees in one jurisdiction

description: Statutory and agency limits on what a lawyer may charge: workers' compensation in every state and DC; Social Security (SSDI and SSI), the Federal Tort Claims Act, VA, Longshore and other federal programs (jurisdiction US); medical-malpractice and general contingency-fee rules where read. Each record gives the cap type, percent, dollar cap or sliding scale, what it applies to, who approves the fee, the statute or rule cited with a quote, and the day it was read. A lookup, not a fee calculator. Results summarize public sources for marketing planning; they are not legal advice.
